This endpoint will email the user with a link to reset the password.
The email will content a url with your return_url and a query parameter "token" with a temporal JWT to reset the password.

In the example, https://yourweb.com/recover-password?token=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
